_comment: Strings that Turnstile adds, which have no upstream translation, plus the handful
of upstream keys that upstream itself left untranslated in some languages.
scripts/import-resx.sh merges this over the .resx import, so re-running the import
The non-English entries were translated by Claude (Opus 5), not by native speakers.
They follow the register upstream already established per language: informal
imperative in German, 'Jouer'/'Installee :' spacing in French, and the polite
declarative style used in the Korean resources. A native speaker should review them
before any wide release; corrections are a one-line edit here.

en.CheckForUpdatesDetail: Asks GitHub whether a newer Turnstile has been released. Nothing is downloaded or installed.

en.ChooseInstaller: Choose the installer you downloaded from GOG.
en.FailedToChangeVersionMode: Failed to change how versions are stored
en.FailedToInstallGameData: Failed to install the game data

en.MultiVersionDisabledMessageOne: 1 other version is still on disk ({0}). Nothing was deleted. Turn this setting back on to use it again.

en.UnrecognisedInstaller: That installer does not hold RollerCoaster Tycoon 1 or 2, or Locomotion.

ca.ChooseInstaller: Tria l'instal.lador que has baixat de GOG.

ca.FailedToObtainBuilds: No s'han pogut obtenir les versions
ca.FailedToReadInstalledVersions: No s'han pogut llegir les versions instal·lades

ca.FailedToRepairInstallation: No s'ha pogut reparar la instal·lació

cs.CheckForUpdatesDetail: Zepta se GitHubu, zda vysla novejsi verze Turnstile. Nic se nestahuje ani neinstaluje.

hu.MultiVersionDisabledMessageOne: További 1 verzió maradt a lemezen ({0}). Semmi nem lett törölve. Kapcsold vissza ezt a beállítást a használatához.
